textRead.detail: Actual native read_text operation/result call_id retains UTF-8 text

toolError.detail: Actual invalid UTF-8 read returns None with a linked file operation/result and native error diagnostic

imageReference.detail: Native image read body retained as a reference in its linked file result

userImageEntry.detail: Native filename argument adds image to user model context; explicit recorder retains reference

noUnrecognized.detail: Initial and restored native records contain no unknown evidence

resume.detail: Native --restore-chat-history reloads prior prompt/answer, verified in the resumed model request. Aider has no native stable session ID; separate explicit launches produce separate recorder streams rather than fabricated continuity.

backfill.detail: Two manual backfills compared against automatic recorder capture after both normal exits
